Mainline adapter via Node native TypeScript loader

tests.name: Independent durable dispatcher regression review
tests.scope: Real service and disk store; stubbed process, membership and transport. Includes 21 logical sessions across three levels, bounded runnable workers, replay, ACK, rollback and cancellation.

tests.name: Native service and browser interactions
tests.scope: Real built app/server/auth; synthetic ended transcripts, collaboration projection and in-memory authorization UI. Backend/extension tests separately cover real authorization decisions.

releaseAudit.scope: Publication allow-list and bounded credential patterns; the six published screenshots were separately reviewed visually.

screenshotScope: Six reviewed screenshots retained from the final run. The raw browser report also enumerates other screenshots generated temporarily by the reproducible launcher.
limitations: No paid-model execution or ten-hour soak test; no user production deployment.
Semantic task decomposition is still model-selected; deterministic enforcement applies to declared plans, scheduling and receipts.
Task grants cover verified joined sessions sharing the approved workspace/operator/charter; unjoined native pi-subagents do not inherit extra rights solely from environment metadata.
Protected or ungrantable paths preserve independent native gates; task grants are not OS privileges, service credentials or a shell sandbox.
The existing workbench-sync identity/access gap remains outside this change; native backend-root resolution is fixed and tested.
Responsive shell remount retains its existing behavior; mobile QA explicitly enters the Agents view.
Full repository typecheck remains nonzero on the recorded existing diagnostics.
